title: GBP/CHF Forecast: Pound Sterling Tipped at 1.14 Over Three Month Timeline
text: The latest exchange rate projections from Rabobank place GBP/CHF at 1.12 in one month, indicating cautious near-term sentiment. Pound Sterling is then expected to strengthen slightly, reaching 1.14 in three months, before modestly easing back to 1.13 at the six- and nine-month horizons.
